Subject: Next steps & quick recap from today's demo

Hi Marta — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our 30-min demo and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) What we saw: Acme ingestion use case looks like a direct fit for Redwood's hosted inference (low-latency reranking + prefix caching for summary workflows).
2) Success criteria you mentioned: ingest pipeline working end-to-end, under 250ms p99 for 1k qps sim load, and ability to pin model versions for audit.
3) Blockers we called out: security questionnaire (your infosec), and dataset onboarding for the demo data.

Proposed immediate actions:
- I can provision a sandbox trial environment today (no infra changes on your side). Attachment: mutual-action-plan-Acme-Analytics.pdf (one-pager with roles & milestones).
- Suggested time for technical kickoff with your infra lead: Tue/Wed next week — I have open slots 10–12 PT.
- If priority changed, please let me know and we can set a lighter touch evaluation (short smoke test) instead.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-Acme-Analytics.pdf, redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (checklist for initial dataset and service account prep).

Thanks,
